theorems.name: Submission.dohr_eb_sch_cacc_exists_cutoff
theorems.statement: ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ (n : ℕ) (y : Rn n) (ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ → ∃ η : Rn n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 η ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ η x ∧ η x ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ x ∈ ball y ρ, η x = 1) ∧ HasCompactSupport η ∧ tsupport η ⊆ ball y (2 * ρ) ∧ ∀ x, ‖fderiv ℝ η x‖ ≤ K / ρ
